create_glm4v_config: create a Glm4vConfig instance for initializing a GLM-4.1V multimodal model
build_glm4v_vision_config: build a Glm4vVisionConfig with custom vision model hyperparameters like hidden_size and patch_size
build_glm4v_text_config: build a Glm4vTextConfig with custom text model hyperparameters like vocab_size and num_hidden_layers
configure_glm4v_token_ids: configure GLM-4.1V image and video special token IDs for multimodal input processing
initialize_glm4v_model: initialize a Glm4vForConditionalGeneration model from a Glm4vConfig configuration object
